title.romaji: Magic Maker: Isekai Mahou no Tsukurikata
title.english: Magic Maker: como fazer mágica em outro mundo
title.japanese: マジック・メイカー －異世界魔法の作り方－
synonyms: Magic Maker: How to Make Magic in Another World
Magic Maker: How to Create Magic in Another World

information.synopsis:
Um homem de 30 anos que sonha em se tornar um bruxo de repente perde a vida. Reencarnado em outro mundo quando era uma criança chamada Shion, ele cresce ao lado de Marie, sua confiável irmã mais velha que o adora. Shion antecipa ansiosamente o uso de poderes mágicos, mas descobre que o novo mundo aparentemente não tem magia. Ele passa os anos seguintes como uma criança sombria e abatida, até que um fenômeno místico em um lago próximo chama a atenção dos irmãos e dá vida ao seu sonho mágico.

Ao fazer experiências com a luz peculiar que emana da água, Shion finalmente confirma que a energia mágica realmente existe. Pode não ser conveniente para nada ainda, mas Shion dedica seu tempo ao estudo da anomalia, determinado a descobrir todas as maravilhas existentes em sua busca para fazer magia.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

episodes.title: Marie e Shion
episodes.overview: Marie absolutely adores her younger brother Shion, everything from the way he secretly plays pretend to the oddly grown-up look he gets sometimes. One day, he asks their father about something called "magic" and their whole lives change.

episodes.title: Não há mágica neste outro mundo
episodes.overview: After yearning for magic throughout his first life, Shion lives his second life in another world without magic. But his sister's discovery at a lake has given him hope. As he researches the luminous phenomenon, he feels his dream stir back to life.

episodes.title: Ataque Goblin
episodes.overview: Goblins are sighted near the village. Gawain goes to hunt them while Shion and others from the village hide in the mansion for protection. Suddenly, there's a pounding at the door and a window shatters—a goblin has broken into the mansion.

episodes.title: A pesquisa mágica começa para valer
episodes.overview: Shion's father finally approves of his magic research, which leads Shion to a new discovery. Marie seems troubled as she devotes herself to her sword.

episodes.title: Minério de Relâmpago e Parafuso
episodes.overview: Shion and Marie's relationship is mostly back to normal. Now, Grast has a problem that only Shion can solve.

episodes.title: Supressão de Guildas e Monstros
episodes.overview: Left shaken by his father's words, Shion continues his research by taking it into the field to hunt monsters.

episodes.title: A vida diária começa a desmoronar
episodes.overview: Two years after Shion and the others' first monster hunt, a mysterious red light flashes through the clouds.

episodes.title: Eu farei a cura
episodes.overview: Marie is gravely ill and strange monsters have attacked. Shion is determined to do everything he can to help.

episodes.title: Doença de Letargia ~Tratamento e Pesquisa~
episodes.overview: Shion devotes himself to finding a cure for lethargy sickness. Rose, worried for her friends, offers to help.

episodes.title: A ameaça noturna chegou
episodes.overview: The night menace appears once more. Shion and the others race out to defend Istria from horde of wraiths.

episodes.title: Feitiçaria e Magia
episodes.overview: Ainswelf's arrival changes everything. Shion steps up to challenge a foe far more powerful than himself.

episodes.title: Quem sou eu realmente?
episodes.overview: Exhausted from the battle, Shion sleeps for a week. He wakes to concerned faces and a mysterious phenomenon.
